dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: Welcome to Mondstadt, traveler. How can I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: We are currently experiencing abnormal weather patterns. It is dangerous outside. Citizens are advised to seek shelter.

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: That dragon could return at any time. The Knights of Favonius will keep watch; everyone else is urged to find shelter immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: This is an emergency. Please be assured that the Knights of Favonius' first priority is to guarantee the safety of everyone in the city.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: I had no idea what to do when the incident had just happened. At least we can finally draw all this to a close.

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: Still, it's quite remarkable that we encountered such an event. Doesn't this mean that we, too, have witnessed history?

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: Well, if anyone asks me for a tale or legend in the future, I'm going to tell them the story of Dvalin.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: Known as both "The Crown of the North" and "The City of Pastoral Song," there are no words that can truly describe the beauty of this city.

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: A new bard arrived in the city not long ago. You should seek him out if you want to feel the true essence of Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: But the songs he plays are... a bit archaic?

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: ...Those songs date back thousands of years. No clue as to how he knows them...

choices.text: Are there any legends about Mondstadt?

response.speaker: Lawrence
response.text: You've come to the right person.

response.speaker: Lawrence
response.text: It's said in Mondstadt, a righteous hero often appears at night.

response.speaker: Lawrence
response.text: But no one knows his true identity...

response.speaker: Lawrence
response.text: I should stop there, or else I'll keep talking about him. If the Acting Grand Master catches me chatting on duty again...

response.speaker: Lawrence
response.text: Sorry, guess I'll talk to you next time.

choices.text: Are there any anecdotes about Mondstadt?

response.speaker: Lawrence
response.text: Anecdotes...? Not sure if this counts as one.

response.speaker: Lawrence
response.text: When I'm on my shift here, I'll sometimes notice the weather change very suddenly.

response.speaker: Lawrence
response.text: Um... Rather than a natural phenomenon, it feels more like someone is manipulating the weather. But who has that much power to do that?

response.speaker: Lawrence
response.text: Even the higher-ranking knights in the Knights of Favonius don't seem to have the ability to do that. How strange.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: Goodbye, traveler. Hope you have a good time in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you know about the Lawrence Clan...?

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: Heh... I actually have no connection at all to the Lawrence Clan. *sigh* It's a bit of a long story...

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: You must know Wagner, the blacksmith? Well, the one other thing he enjoys besides working with metal is drinking competitions. Placing a bet and seeing who can drink the most. The drunker he gets, the more outrageous the bets become...

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: The whole reason his shop is called "Schulz's Blacksmith" is because he lost to his apprentice, Schulz, in a drinking game.

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: ...Ahem, now, my father is a merchant from Fontaine, and he came to Mondstadt to do business. Though, you'd be forgiven for thinking he came for the drinking culture alone...

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: One day, the two of them got drinking together. My father bet on his son's name — that is to say, my name, and... yeah.

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: *sigh* At that time, my father was not to know that the name "Lawrence" came with so much baggage...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, what was the outcome?

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: The outcome... well, as you can attest to, every few days, I get someone coming up to me and asking what my connection with the Lawrence Clan is.

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: My father gets extremely remorseful about the whole thing every time I bring it up...

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: ...Mostly because if he'd just managed to get one more drink down him, Wagner would have had to name his most prized weapon "Pinky the Rabbit"... *sigh* ...
